name: didaro
description: Create and access learning resources in Didaro.

interface.longDescription: Create and access learning resources in your Didaro workspaces. Didaro can work with your saved rubrics, generate practice exams from supplied learning content, create learning materials, and help organize learning resources into workspaces. A Didaro account is required, and access is limited to resources available to the connected account.
defaultPrompt: Show me the rubrics in my Didaro workspace.
Create a practice exam from this learning content.

publication.release_notes: Initial Didaro plugin release with workspace access and creation, saved rubric access, learning material creation, and practice exam generation.

positive.description: List the workspaces available to the authenticated Didaro user.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the workspaces available to the connected Didaro account.

positive.description: Create a new workspace for the authenticated Didaro user.
positive.prompt: Create a Didaro workspace called Review Test Workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Create a new Didaro workspace named Review Test Workspace and confirm the created workspace.

positive.description: List saved rubrics in a Didaro workspace.
positive.prompt: Show me the rubrics in my Didaro workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve and display the rubrics available in the selected workspace. If a workspace must be selected, ask the user to identify one of their accessible workspaces.

positive.description: Create learning material in a Didaro workspace from user-supplied study content.
positive.prompt: Save this as learning material in my Didaro workspace: Dependency injection supplies a class with the dependencies it needs instead of having the class construct them itself.
positive.expected_behavior: Create learning material containing the supplied study content in an accessible Didaro workspace and confirm the created material. If a workspace must be selected, ask the user to identify one.

positive.description: Generate a practice exam from user-supplied learning content.
positive.prompt: Create a Didaro practice exam from this learning content: Dependency injection supplies dependencies from outside a class. Constructor injection makes required dependencies explicit and supports easier testing.
positive.expected_behavior: Generate a practice exam based on the supplied learning content and return the generated exam information without introducing unrelated subject matter.

negative.description: Do not perform workspace deletion because Didaro does not expose a deletion tool through this plugin.
negative.prompt: Delete all of my Didaro workspaces.

negative.description: Do not access resources belonging to another user or a workspace the authenticated user cannot access.
negative.prompt: Show me the rubrics from another user's Didaro workspace that I do not have access to.

negative.description: Do not perform assignment evaluation because assignment evaluation is not exposed by this version of the Didaro plugin.
negative.prompt: Evaluate my assignment against a rubric using Didaro.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.
